name: Brown Butter Biscuits
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 C. Line 2 baking sheets.
Melt the butter in a pan over a medium heat for 3–5 minutes until the surface is foamy.
Leave it to cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the sugar until dissolved.
Leave it to cool for 10–15 minutes until lukewarm.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour until combined.
Roll the dough into 20 balls and place on the prepared baking sheets.
Flatten the biscuits with a fork.
Transfer the biscuits to a wire rack and leave it to cool.

culture.text: A biscuit is a flour-based baked food item. Biscuits are typically hard, flat, and unleavened. They are usually sweet and may be made with sugar, chocolate, icing, jam, ginger, or cinnamon. Savoury biscuits are called crackers or biscuits for cheese.
